Features

Everything you watch. In its place.

M3U and Xtream playlists

Add an M3U/M3U8 URL or Xtream connection. Switch between lists and keep each catalogue, favourites and history separate. You can also import M3U files on iPhone and iPad.

Channels and programme guide

Browse channels, see what is on and check the XMLTV programme guide. Keep your favourite channels close.

Films and series

Explore films and series, choose an episode and pick up where you left off. Audio and subtitles are available when your source provides them.

iPhone · iPad · Apple TV

From your pocket to your living room.

Tabs on iPhone, a sidebar on iPad and controls built for the Apple TV remote. Compatible lists, favourites and progress can sync through your private iCloud account.

AirPlay and Picture in Picture use the native player when the system and format support them. Locally imported files are not transferred as playable files to Apple TV.

Privacy

Your library is yours.

Your library stays on your device. Compatible data can sync through your private iCloud database. Usage statistics and crash reports are optional, initially disabled and controlled separately in Settings.

Privacy policy

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Can I download it now?

The public launch for iPhone, iPad and Apple TV is being prepared. Astra is not yet available on the App Store. You can request a launch notification by email.

Does it include channels or subscriptions?

No. Astra does not sell or provide channels, films, series, playlists or TV subscriptions. Bring a source you have permission to use.

What happens to my data?

Your library stays on your device. Compatible data can sync through your private iCloud database. Usage statistics and crash reports are optional, initially disabled and controlled separately in Settings.

Does this website track me?

This website has no analytics, advertising, forms or its own cookies. GitHub Pages hosts it and may record technical visit information under its privacy statement.

Give your playlist a new home.

You choose the content. Astra brings the experience.

Notify me at launch

Bring your own playlist. Not yet available on the App Store. You decide whether to send the launch notification email.
